name: higgsfield_pay_as_you_go_api_cost_reduction
summary: Bypass fixed monthly subscriptions by using direct pay-as-you-go API keys for Higgsfield models to cut generation costs up to 45%.
steps: Navigate to cloud.higgsfield.ai to access API developer portal.
Generate an API Key ID and Key Secret.
Deposit initial credits into the pay-as-you-go balance.
Route generation requests through custom API scripts rather than the subscription web tier.
jarvis_use: Enable Jarvis to make direct pay-as-you-go API requests instead of paying recurring monthly subscription fees.

name: higgsfield_api_credentials_env_setup
summary: Configure local environment credentials for Higgsfield API using key-id:key-secret pairing in .env.local.
steps: Create or open .env.local in project root.
Add environment variable line HF_CREDENTIALS=key-id:key-secret without quotes.
Add .env.local to .gitignore to prevent accidental remote credential leakage.
jarvis_use: Allow Jarvis to securely read and inject Higgsfield API credentials locally for automated execution.

name: claude_code_multi_stage_prompt_pack_execution
summary: Generate complete full-stack web applications by pasting structured sequential prompt packs into Claude Code CLI.
steps: Open terminal inside target directory and start Claude Code session.
Select preferred model (e.g. Sonnet 5.5).
Paste system build prompt blocks sequentially into Claude Code CLI.
Allow Claude Code to scaffold files, install dependencies, and launch local web server.
jarvis_use: Jarvis can execute multi-stage prompt packs in CLI to build target tools and local dashboards on demand.

name: higgsfield_client_npm_video_generation
summary: Invoke @higgsfield/client SDK in Node.js/TypeScript to trigger AI video generation tasks.
steps: Install @higgsfield/client package via npm.
Import Higgsfield client into TypeScript execution file.
Call Higgsfield.subscribe() specifying target model (e.g. bytedance/seedance-2.5/text-to-video).
Pass prompt and parameters in request payload and wait for output Cloudfront asset URL.
jarvis_use: Provide Jarvis with programmatic TypeScript endpoints for generating AI video clips.

name: zero_retry_api_charge_prevention
summary: Set maxRetries to 0 on paid API client calls to avoid duplicate billing on network timeouts or failures.
steps: Inspect SDK initialisation or call configuration.
Explicitly set maxRetries property to 0.
Handle network failures in application logic without auto-retrying billable requests.
jarvis_use: Ensure Jarvis never incurs duplicate charges on paid API calls due to automatic retry loops.

name: env_credential_missing_failure_recovery
summary: Catch missing HF_CREDENTIALS configuration errors on script launch and remediate before re-running.
steps: Run application startup command (npm start).
Observe CLI error output indicating empty or missing HF_CREDENTIALS.
Populate .env.local with valid key-id:key-secret pair.
Re-execute npm start to verify successful server initialization.
jarvis_use: Enable Jarvis to self-diagnose missing credential errors and prompt or fix environment files automatically.

name: dynamic_pre_execution_cost_calculation_ui
summary: Display dynamic cost calculations on UI action buttons before triggering billable generation requests.
steps: Define cost-per-unit rates for each engine in frontend state (e.g., Ideogram $0.06/img, Seedance $2.31/clip).
Listen to user selections for slide counts, clip duration, or quality tier.
Multiply engine unit rate by requested output quantity.
Update action button text dynamically (e.g., 'MAKE THE CAROUSEL $0.24').
jarvis_use: Give Jarvis and users total cost transparency before executing any automated asset generation.

name: multi_engine_carousel_generator_ui
summary: Build a multi-engine carousel creation UI supporting style presets and selectable rendering engines.
steps: Create visual preset picker (e.g., Big Number, Editorial, Cinematic, Photo).
Add engine selection toggles (Ideogram 4.0, GPT Image 2.5, Grok Imagine 2.0).
Provide slide count input and automated topic text generation prompt.
Send generation payload to selected engine API endpoint.
jarvis_use: Allow Jarvis to produce multi-slide social carousels selecting optimal rendering engines.

name: engine_selection_by_use_case_optimization
summary: Select specific generation engines based on text precision vs budget constraints.
steps: Evaluate requirements: check if clear text rendering or budget minimization is priority.
If text precision is required, select Ideogram 4.0 ($0.06/img) or GPT Image 2.5 ($0.05/img).
If low-cost video output is required, select Wan 2.7 ($0.25/clip) over Seedance 2.5 ($2.31/clip).
Pass selected engine key into backend request.
jarvis_use: Allow Jarvis to pick the cheapest model that satisfies technical output constraints.

name: auto_dm_keyword_trigger_funnel
summary: Set up automated social media DM responses triggered by specific post comment keywords.
steps: Configure social posting connection credentials (Blotato or Zernio) in settings desk.
Navigate to Auto DMs desk and create new rule.
Enter target trigger keyword (e.g., 'JARVIS').
Provide automated response message containing download links or assets.
Enable post monitoring to automatically direct message commenting users.
jarvis_use: Enable Jarvis to automatically send lead magnets or links to users commenting on social posts.

name: spark_studio_local_web_desk
summary: Structure a local full-stack control dashboard on localhost:4777 for content creation and management.
steps: Scaffold local Node.js web application.
Implement routing for Studio, Dashboard, Approve, Auto DMs, Deals, Calendar, Reports, and Settings desks.
Run npm start and launch dashboard on localhost:4777.
Connect backend endpoints to local storage and external APIs.
jarvis_use: Provide Jarvis with a unified web UI local control panel to manage content, automation, and API settings.
